description:
Matsya 6000 is India's first deep-sea sub for people: three Indians inside a titanium sphere, six kilometres under the sea.
The hardest part to make was a weld, and ISRO made it. It took about 700 trial welds for 32 minutes that had to be perfect.
How the Samudrayaan sphere was built, how it differs from Titan, what is still missing, and what India wants to see on the seabed.
